sources.scope: Public abstract and bibliographic context only: joint/muscle sensory feedback in this species. No measured joint angles, footfall phases, forces, neural mechanism or experimental gait sequence was imported.

shape.before: Smooth ellipsoid, weak margin, thin stick limbs, simple fingers and unresolved ventral anatomy.
shape.changed: Continuous broad domed carapace with rounded margin lobes and regional cues; eight fixed-length plated walking legs with joint membranes and setae; low support; paired short eye stalks; curved heavy black-tipped chelae with a hinged dactyl.
shape.remaining: Proportions and lobe arrangement selected by visual reference, not digitized morphometrics. Simplified mouthparts, gills, internal anatomy and sex/age/moult variation.

surface.before: Near-uniform smooth brown surfaces without distinct cuticle, black tips or fine relief.
surface.changed: Original numerical pigment, fine granular instancing and exportable normal field; dorsal/ventral leg color separation. Reversed segment winding found during visual review was corrected before final captures.
surface.remaining: No scan, calibrated albedo/roughness, measured chitin optics or individual wear. Color and fine relief remain an approximation of the selected photographic phenotype.

movement.before: Local finger motion on fixed limbs; no working supported walk.
movement.changed: Same meshes/materials throughout a short lateral walking bout with fixed segment lengths, planted stance tips and lifted recovery; settles and holds. Local search/handling, chela opening and lowered supported rest.
movement.remaining: Authored phases, angles and uncalibrated seconds. No experimental gait data, force balance, proprioceptive control, continuous collision solver, food capture, ingestion, physiological process or sleep claim.

reviewMethod: Author compared all42 final actual WebGL2 captured states on five labelled sheets against the retained licensed real photograph and selected institutional morphology/joint literature. This is not independent specialist review or a quantitative biological accuracy measurement.
